tool_calls.name: run_python
tool_calls.code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
df = pd.read_csv('daily_cost_1.csv')
rows=[]
for (a,s), g in df.groupby(['SubAccountName','ServiceName']):
    c = g['BilledCost']
    med = c.median()
    mad = (c-med).abs().median()
    for _, r in g.iterrows():
        z = 0.6745*(r['BilledCost']-med)/mad if mad>0 else 0
        rows.append((r['ChargePeriodStart'], a, s, r['BilledCost'], z))
t = pd.DataFrame(rows, columns=['date','account','service','cost','z']).sort_values('z',ascending=False)
print(t.head(8).to_string())
